notes: Triggers when 5+ grey nomads are within 6 tiles of the player at sleep 0 (or via #mg hash). Eight nomads approach in a ring from distance 180. Player left-clicks to brighten the flame (+0.18, decays -0.006/frame). The steady target band drifts every 120 frames. Nomads commit and advance when flame is in-band, recoil when too bright (>target+0.25), drift away when too dim (<target-0.15). Win: all close to distance 32, converts up to 3 greys to devout. Fail: nomads scatter/fade, burns 2 NPCs. The flame is drawn above the player; nomad commitment shows as opacity and posture (line when hesitant). Entry transition is a 48-frame fade-in with the flame igniting; exit is 60-frame kneel (win) or 50-frame scatter (fail). The Instructor's line displays exactly once on first activation (including #mg), before the entry transition completes. [DIRECTOR'S REPAIR 2026-08-18: base = mg-live-build-v4 patch-attempt-2. Sixth fix: edge-triggered taps (a held pointer fed the flame every frame; one press is one breath).
